title: Étale locality of the exceptional orientation
statement:
Fix the finite-coefficient datum $k,\ell,E,n,\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ of [sk-def-purity-conv]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a regular closed immersion of pure codimension $c\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with $X$ smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and $Z$ regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Use the specified diagonal smooth orientations $\Pi_{a_X}$ and $\Pi_{a_Z}$ of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object], and let $\Phi_i:\Lambda_Z\to Ri^!(\Lambda_X(c)[2c])$ be the composite of [pur9-rg-def-phi], with the adjunction-preserving exceptional composition comparison of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition]. Let $u:U\to X$ be an etale morphism with $U$ separated and finite type over $k$, and put $V=Z\times_XU$, with maps $v:V\to Z$ and $i_U:V\hookrightarrow U$ [def-weil-etale-morphism].

The canonical identifications $Ru^!\cong Lu^*$ and $Rv^!\cong Lv^*$ on bounded constructible inputs identify their relative-dimension-zero smooth orientations with the unit orientations. The resulting comparison
$$B_{u,i}:Ri_U^!Lu^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_U^!Ru^!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(ui_U)^!=R(iv)^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rv^!Ri^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Lv^*Ri^!$$
is compatible with the co-projection maps for Tate shifts [lem-pur-coprojection] and satisfies
$$B_{u,i}\circ\Phi_{i_U}=Lv^*\Phi_i,$$
using $Lv^*\Lambda_Z=\Lambda_V$ and $Lu^*\Lambda_X(c)=\Lambda_U(c)$. The same assertion applies componentwise when the smooth dimensions vary. This is an assertion about the specified orientation composite, without identifying it with any Kummer or fundamental class.
